description: A peer that has sent no recommendation gets drc.default_speed; once its MAX-SPEED has come, the next transmission to it goes at that rung.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. 0.0.1.3 sends only CAPABILITY at 2000, so the first transmission, at 52000, goes at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long (plan 6.2; interp C-1284): the type 7 with SENDER-APPROACH (0xB04, interp C-1286) and 20 PADDING with MAX-SEGMENT 255, 5550 ms. At 60000 a second burst from 0.0.1.3 holds one PADDING to us, EOT 10 (end 66000), EOW MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6: interleaver code 101, speed 6; C-0459, C-0462). Nothing is queued, so no VDCD timer runs (K-0111). At 63000 conn 1 sends 'again' to 0.0.1.3 (TTD 63000 + 1296000000 ms): dts.ttd starts, and with the prediction ahead, csma.vdcd_end runs to 66000; then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and contention, the second draw of seed 0, slot 4, 12000 ms (K-0080). At 78000 the type 7 (C_PDU ID 1, C-1040) goes at WN 6 Long, the rung MAX-SPEED names, which is on the ladder (open question 5, interp C-1280). Its D_PDUs are within one 256-byte block, so this is not a bulk transmission and LOW-SPEED would be used, but none has come, so MAX-SPEED stands in (interp C-1284). Fixture WN 6 Long: 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block (test data).
